import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for sheet in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())

import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)

grand_total = 0.0
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (shape={df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    numeric = df.select_dtypes(include='number')
    total = numeric.to_numpy().sum()
    grand_total += total
    print(f"Sheet '{name}' numeric total: {total:.2f}")

print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL (all sheets, all numeric cells): {grand_total:.2f}")
